A '''chewstick''' was a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]]. It could be [[fizzyglug]] flavored. The [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] [[Slythor]] once included a piece of fizzyglug-flavored chewstick in the deal that saw him gain possession of a badly damaged [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]].
